description: This project summarizes the CLIP-based cross-modal hashing methods. Including DCMHT, MITH, DSPH, DNPH, TwDH (Two-Step Discrete Hashing for Cross-Modal Retrieval), DIMCH(Cross-modal Hashing via Diverse Instances Matching), UMoED(A Unified Generative Hashing for Cross-Modal Retrieval).
